text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's after curfew, and campus is silent. I'm
heading
back to my office to grab
something I forgot,
when...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer! What a coinkydink! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm ghost-hunting!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We watched a spooky show on TV, so I
started
wondering if there were any
ghosts on campus.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
O-obviously not, right? But she won't
listen...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
R-r-r-r-right?! We've already looked
everywhere,
so let's just go home!
choice_data_list: 門限過ぎてるし帰らないと
choice_data_list_en: It's already past curfew, we've gotta head back.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What?! But there's still one more place!
We
haven't checked Trainer's office yet!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A long, long time ago, there was a racer
who died
in an accident before she got
her signature
racewear...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Her ghost appears each night in the
office, crying
out, "Where's my signature
racewear?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, stop... Y-you're just making
things up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You don't know that! Trainer, please
take us to
your office!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun won't back down, so I
end up
taking them back with me to my
office.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Here, ghosty ghosty ghosty! Come out,
come out,
wherever you are!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you doing?! What if
something
actually comes out?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wandering ghost who wants to try on
her
signature racewear just once...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wandering ghost who wants to try on
her
signature racewear just once...
choice_data_list: その幽霊は無念だっただろうな
その幽霊は無念だっただろうね
choice_data_list_en: That ghost must've had lingering regrets, huh.
That ghost must've had lingering regrets, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mention that there's no doubt she
dreamed of
racing on the turf in her
signature racewear.
choice_data_list: その幽霊は無念だっただろうな
その幽霊は無念だっただろうね
choice_data_list_en: That ghost must've had lingering regrets, huh.
That ghost must've had lingering regrets, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I bet she really loved running...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She must be in so much pain—lonely too!
That's
why she comes here! I know I
would!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah...
choice_data_list: 無念を晴らしてやりたいな
無念を晴らしてやりたいね
choice_data_list_en: I'd really like to clear away that regret.
It'd be nice to help clear away that regret.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I know! I'll run for her sake!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Since she can't run anymore, I'll run in
tons of
races for her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock, knock!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Something just knocked on the
window!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Let's go home already! I don't
wanna get
possessed!
choice_data_list: 『ありがとう』って言ってくれたのかも

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But it would be fun to be friends
with a
ghost. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Right, Miss Ghost? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! Miss Ghost, I promise to do my
best for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Almost as if she's picked up a tailwind,
Mayano
Top Gun runs off with a spring
in her step.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaah! It's the ghost!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Heeelp meee!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We take off after Tokai Teio, but she's
in such a
panic that we soon lose sight of
her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: She must be really scared of ghosts...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, she probably didn't take any
dark and
scary paths.
choice_data_list: どこに行ったんだろう

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So the answer is simple! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Mayano Top Gun, who says she
knows
where Tokai Teio went...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Target confirmed! Found ya, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She comes back to the dorms with us,
but doesn't
say a word the whole way
there.
choice_data_list: さっきは脅かしてごめんな
さっきは脅かしてごめんね

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame we didn't see any ghosts last
night,
huh? Got my hopes up for
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's a good thing! I was so worried
about you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You didn't come back to the dorm! I
tried calling
but couldn't get a hold of
you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? But you came back with us, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No, I went back to the dorm by myself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Then who was the Teio that was with
us last
night?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun and Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!
